headline: SELENITIC is walkable
lede: MYST's moonlit Age grew from one view into five: a field of stepping stones that sing in pitch order, a throne that opens the mountain only when sun and moon share its arch, and a brass gear waiting on the summit.

notes.text: Sounding path: six stones sized by pitch — walk the ascending route or a sour buzz resets you, exactly as the 1993 original played it.
Sun-and-moon throne: eight notches, one true alignment; the arch frames both lights and the mountain door slides aside.
Summit gear: one of Mechanical's five, carried as a flag — wiring the five into the red-page seal is a noted follow-up.
Harness: mystcheck 151 to 198 gates, 7 new Selenitic mutants (21 total, all die); viewcheck frames all 22 views.

look.text: Walk the sounding path under the huge moon
